source: Inventario de Arboles Singulares de la Ciudad de Sevilla (2022), Ayuntamiento de Sevilla. All 84 fichas parsed: 56 individual trees and 28 arboledas.
per_tree_pages: https://www.sevilla.org/documentos/parquesyjardines/ArbolesSingularesSevilla/[n]/ mirrors each ficha on the web. Same authority as the PDF, so it is not an independent second source.
fetch_note: The PDF is 35,972,899 bytes. A plain curl truncates it near 8 MB and every parser then dies on an xref error. Resume with curl -C - in a loop until the file ends in %%EOF, then read with pdfminer. sevilla.org refuses plain curl connections; femas.es serves the identical file.
coordinate_warning: Catalogue coordinates are not always right. Ficha 15 (El Eucalipto del Parking el Valle, Calle del Cristo de las Cinco Llagas, barrio Santa Catalina) carries the coordinates of ficha 14 (El Gran Capitan, Paseo de Catalina de Ribera), about 1.2 km away. Check every coordinate against its emplazamiento before publishing.
taxonomy_warning: Ficha 52 files Feijoa sellowiana under Arecaceae, the palm family. It is Myrtaceae. Do not trust the family field.
vitality_warning: The catalogue has no expiry and is already stale. Ficha 45, El Ficus de la Plaza de la Encarnacion, was felled on 24 October 2023, sixteen months after the catalogue was dated. A designation is not a live check.
condition_note: This is the only register in the project carrying vitality fields, and it carries four per tree: estado fisiologico, estado fitosanitario, estado biomecanico and estado general de conservacion. All four are recorded verbatim on every entry below and were used to filter this list.

Proof that the 2022 catalogue is already stale on vitality: every candidate needs a live check, not just a species check.

note_2026_08_14: Write pass 2026-08-14: sev_017 to sev_020 delivered (Alcazar magnolia, Alcazar Judas tree, Naranjo de Pedro el Cruel, Platano de la Muralla). All four are single-sourced on the municipal catalogue and ship flagged, with the catalogue's own condition wording quoted in the prose and no age claimed anywhere. Two Alcazar pins are marked approximate because the catalogue coordinate does not agree with its own emplazamiento field: ficha 8 sits ~80 m west of the published Jardin Ingles pin (sev_001), ficha 9 ~50 m southwest of the point described between the Pabellon de Carlos V and the Cenador del Leon. That is the coordinate_warning at the top of this file showing up again, and it is the reason to check every remaining Alcazar ficha against its emplazamiento before shipping it.
